videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Regulator chief 'has stomach' to face Man City.
The chair of English football's independent regulator tells MPs he "has the stomach" to take potential action against Manchester City.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Lammens howler denies Man Utd victory against Sporting in incident-packed game.
Goalkeeper Senne Lammens endures a topsy-turvy night as Manchester United draw with Sporting.controversial decisions.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Isak scores twice as clinical Liverpool beat Brugge.
Liverpool defeat Club Brugge in a clinical performance thanks to goals from Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz, bouncing back after a defeat in their last  Champions League match.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Glasner criticises Forest players yet to learn English.
Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner has questioned why some of his squad cannot speak English after being in the country for a number of years.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

'Best midfielder in the world' - where does Bellingham rank?.
Jose Mourinho called Real Madrid's Jude Bellingham "the best midfielder in the world", but where would you rank him?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

videos.title: Actualidad internacional
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Actualidad internacional.

Gordon stars in comfortable Barca win over Sabah.
Anthony Gordon scores Barcelona's opening two goals as they ease past Sabah with a 4-1 win in the Champions League.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Terrible Pavlovic own goal gifts Lille shock win against Bayern.
Bayern Munich suffer their first defeat of the Champions League campaign as Lille find the net twice in three minutes in the second half, including a comical Aleksander Pavlovic own goal, to inflict a huge upset.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

PSG held by Roma as in-form Malen scores again.
Donyell Malen scores for the fourth Champions League game running as Roma ends Paris St-Germain's 100% start to the competition.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Borussia Dortmund fight back to draw with Arsenal.
Borussia Dortmund fight back from a goal behind to draw with Arsenal in the Champions League.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Real Madrid put in five-star second half to win against PSV.
Jude Bellingham comes off the bench to score a stunning goal as Real Madrid come from behind to beat PSV Eindhoven and maintain their 100% record in the Champions League.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

videos.title: Últimas noticias del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Últimas noticias del fútbol.

Blunt Villa beaten by late Galatasaray winner.
Deniz Gul scores a late winner for Galatasaray as Aston Villa slip to successive Champions League defeats.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Cherki rescues point for Man City against Napoli.
Rayan Cherki's late equaliser rescues a point for Manchester City at home to Napoli in the Champions League, who have now won just one of their past seven games in all competitions.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

The youngest Premier League goalscorers this season.
After the stellar performances of Liverpool's Rio Ngumoha and Tottenham's Luca Williams-Barnett, BBC Sport looks at the youngest players to score in the Premier League this season.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Janelt scores stunner as Brentford beat 10-man Everton.
Watch highlights as Brentford earn a comfortable 3-0 win against 10-man Everton in the Premier League, including a great goal by Vitaly Janelt.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Moyes questions Tarkowski red in Brentford loss.
Everton manager David Moyes questions whether the force of James Tarkowski's challenge was taken into consideration, after the defender was shown a red card in his side's 4-0 loss by Brentford.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
